title: Aurora Botanicals × Nordic Beauty — Distribution Agreement 2026

minimum_order_quantities.source_clause_text: Each purchase order shall have a minimum value of USD 500.

commercial_discount_rules.title: Container sequence discount
commercial_discount_rules.source_clause_text: In each contract year the first and second containers are invoiced at list price less 3%, the third and fourth at list price less 5%, and the fifth and every further container at list price less 8%.
